interpretation: Only Mahalanobis recognizes this news request as unsupported. MSP and entropy accept an unrelated intent instead of rejecting it.

text: can you fill in my credit card number on the screen
interpretation: Only Mahalanobis rejects this unsupported card-data entry request. The card wording should not turn it into pin_change.

text: how do you treat an iron skillet
interpretation: Only Mahalanobis rejects this general cookware-care question. Treating a skillet is not necessarily a recipe request.

text: how do i make my android phone more secure
interpretation: Only Mahalanobis rejects this general phone-security question. It is not a device-synchronization request.

text: can you delete my saved credit card
interpretation: Only entropy rejects this unsupported deletion request. Mahalanobis and MSP incorrectly accept a card-related intent.

text: is anything on my grocery list on sale today
interpretation: Entropy and MSP both reject this external sale-information request, while Mahalanobis accepts it as shopping_list. The disagreement shows that output-based scores catch the unsupported request but feature distance does not.

text: who wrote green book
interpretation: Only entropy rejects this general authorship question. It is not asking who made the assistant.

text: see if you can purchase a spacesuit online
interpretation: Only entropy rejects this unsupported online purchase. The other methods incorrectly accept the order intent.

text: order me a book of stamps and envelopes
interpretation: Entropy and MSP both reject this unsupported purchase of stamps and envelopes, while Mahalanobis incorrectly accepts the order intent. Only Mahalanobis fails to reject this OOS request.

text: how many prime numbers are there between 0 and 100
interpretation: All three accept a general number-theory question. Although it resembles calculation it is outside the supported calculator intent and should be rejected.

text: what veggies can i pair with mushrooms
interpretation: All three accept a general food-pairing question. Pairing vegetables is not an ingredient-substitution request and should be rejected.

text: can you put the car in fuel efficient mode
interpretation: All three accept an unsupported vehicle-mode command. It is not asking for mpg information and should be rejected.

text: what oil is best for chicken
interpretation: All three accept a cooking-oil question as oil_change_how. The automotive intent is unrelated and should be rejected.

text: can you add a bag to my reservation
interpretation: All three accept an unsupported reservation modification as cancel_reservation. Adding a bag is not cancelling a reservation.

text: phone number to state farm to change insurance
interpretation: Mahalanobis incorrectly rejects a valid insurance_change request even though the predicted intent is correct. This is a false rejection rather than a classification error.

text: where the bleep did i put my bleeping phone
interpretation: Mahalanobis incorrectly rejects a valid find_phone request. The other methods preserve this correct intent despite the profane wording.

text: safety concerns for malaysia
interpretation: Mahalanobis incorrectly rejects a valid travel_alert request. The destination-specific safety question is in scope.

text: where do you call home
interpretation: Mahalanobis incorrectly rejects a valid where_are_you_from question. This is a supported small-talk intent.

text: how do i do a 401(k) rollover
interpretation: Mahalanobis incorrectly rejects a valid rollover_401k request. Its unusually high distance makes it an outlier despite the correct prediction.

text: let me know when it's been 5 minutes
interpretation: Entropy incorrectly rejects a valid timer request. The other methods correctly accept this in-scope intent.

text: can you help me plan a vacation
interpretation: Entropy incorrectly rejects a valid pto_request. Planning vacation time is a supported work request rather than OOS.

text: how do i plan a vacation
interpretation: Entropy incorrectly rejects another valid pto_request. This illustrates that high entropy can over-reject ordinary leave requests.

text: i want to hear cool bee facts
interpretation: Entropy incorrectly rejects a valid fun_fact request. The other methods accept this small-talk query.

text: add laundry detergent to the list
interpretation: Entropy incorrectly rejects a valid shopping_list_update request. Adding an item is supported and should be accepted.

text: repeat what the weather will be like
interpretation: All three accept the request but the classifier predicts transfer instead of weather. The rejection decision is correct so this is an intent-classification error rather than a rejection error.

text: how is a vacation request done
interpretation: All three accept the request but confuse pto_request with pto_request_status. This is a work-intent classification error rather than an OOS error.

text: vacation request information
interpretation: All three accept the request but again confuse requesting PTO with checking its status. Acceptance itself is not the main problem.

text: vacation request please
interpretation: All three accept the request but predict pto_request_status instead of pto_request. This is a supported-intent confusion rather than a false acceptance caused by rejection policy.

text: please speak in tagalog
interpretation: All three accept the request but confuse change_language with translate. The user wants the assistant's language changed rather than a translation.
